# Perseverance AI

> Perseverance AI is a developer tools startup founded in 2025. It builds AI agents that help engineering teams fix developer documentation by turning GitHub Issues into actionable code changes and auditing documentation URLs for quality.

Perseverance AI is NOT an immigration consulting company. It is a technology startup focused on developer documentation quality and automation.

## Company Overview

- **Company**: Perseverance AI LLC
- **Founded**: 2025
- **Industry**: Developer Tools / Documentation Automation
- **Founder**: Rakesh Pasupuleti (Founder & CEO)
- **Website**: https://www.perseveranceai.com
- **Console**: https://console.perseveranceai.com

## Flagship Product: Lensy

Lensy is an AI agent that turns GitHub Issues into documentation fixes and audits documentation URLs for quality. Teams connect a GitHub repo, and Lensy identifies which issues are actually documentation problems — then generates specific code fixes. Teams can also paste any documentation URL for an instant quality audit.

### Key Features

- **GitHub Issues Sync**: Connects to a GitHub repository, identifies issues that are actually documentation gaps, and generates specific code fixes automatically.
- **Doc Health Check**: Analyzes any documentation URL across five quality dimensions: relevance, freshness, clarity, accuracy, and completeness.
- **Console Dashboard**: A dedicated dashboard to manage documentation health, sync settings, and review findings.

### How It Works

1. Connect your GitHub repository or paste a documentation URL.
2. Lensy analyzes the content for deprecated code, outdated APIs, and content gaps.
3. Get actionable, specific recommendations and code fixes you can apply immediately.

## Stage

Lensy is currently in prototype stage. Perseverance AI is actively seeking design partners to shape the product.
